concept: Describe your current stress or mood and AI designs a matching karesansui (dry rock garden) layout from real traditional design principles, with an explanation of the raked-gravel pattern and rock arrangement chosen.
Describe a scene or feeling and AI matches it to a real ukiyo-e woodblock print and artist (Hokusai, Hiroshige, Utamaro, etc.), explaining why the print fits and the printmaking technique behind it.
